# AI with Pelumi
Practical AI education for working professionals, taught by Pelumi Fatoye, a product marketer who builds the AI systems he teaches.

## Topics
- Content Engine: how to repurpose one idea into emails, blogs, and newsletters with AI
- Build It, Don't Learn It: how to build websites, AI agents, and automations with no code
- Your AI Workforce: how to build AI assistants for outreach, meetings, social, research, and operations
- Prompt to Production: how to turn prompts into videos, UGC ads, presentations, and flyers

## Newsletter
Weekly newsletter at https://aiwithpelumi.com/

Every issue is free to read at https://aiwithpelumi.com/posts/
